DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A.

The prolonged Partial Thromboplastin Time (60 sec) with normal platelet count and fibrinogen suggests a factor VIII deficiency. Have you or your family members ever been diagnosed with a similar bleeding disorder?
